description: 1934 is the Year of the Wood Dog in the Chinese zodiac, from February 14, 1934 to February 3, 1935. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1934 is the Year of the Wood Dog, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 14, 1934 and ended on February 3, 1935, so people born in 1934 before Feb 14 belong to the Water Rooster year.

sections.heading: When the 1934 Wood Dog year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1934 Wood Dog year began at Lunar New Year on February 14, 1934 and lasted until February 3, 1935, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 14 1934 therefore belongs to the Water Rooster year that started in 1933, while someone born in early 1935, up to Feb 3, is still a Wood Dog. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Wood Dog combination also falls in 1994, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1934 fell on a Wednesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Wood Dog personality
paragraphs: Wood Dog years are associated with warm, fair-minded and idealistic people. Wood stirring the Dog's Earth is read as an opening force, so the loyal Dog becomes more trusting, sociable and drawn to wider causes. People born then are often champions of the overlooked. The usual caution is worry kept private and loyalty spread too thinly across too many commitments.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: 1934 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the digits reduce to 8, associated with ambition, authority and material results, so an 8 year is described in terms of effort and reward. The digits of 1934 add up to 17, which reduces to 8. In the twelve-year cycle the Dog is the eleventh animal, earthly branch Xu, with Earth as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Wood, and in the five-element cycles wood controls Earth. The year before was the Water Rooster and the year after is the Wood Pig.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Jia-Xu: Jia is the Wood heavenly stem and Xu is the Dog's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1934?
faq.answer: 1934 is the Year of the Wood Dog. It started on February 14, 1934 and ended on February 3, 1935.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1934?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 14. Born before February 14, 1934, you are a Water Rooster; born on or after it, you are a Wood Dog.

faq.question: What element is 1934 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yang year. The Dog's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1934?
faq.answer: Jia-Xu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Dog year?
faq.answer: 1994, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1994.
